verdict.rationale: Martin is an AI personal assistant, so grouping chats and files into a project or space with shared context and instructions is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents notes, to-dos, reminders, shortcuts and channel integrations. Nothing describes projects, spaces, or grouping chats and files under shared context or instructions; notes and shortcuts are adjacent features only.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can organize related chats and files into a project or space that shares context and instructions
